elements.description:
MCP servers and their status: add one (transport, auth, test), inspect the tools, resources and prompts it exposes,
connect, disconnect, retry and remove – the app does the connecting.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The servers. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: connections
properties.description: What the app knows about each server's connection, by server id; a server without one is not connected

properties.name: transports
properties.default: [ { id: "stdio", label: "stdio", kind: "command", description: "A local process the app starts and talks to over stdin and stdout" }, { id: "http", label: "HTTP", kind: "url", description: "Streamable HTTP at a URL – most remote servers" }, { id: "sse", label: "SSE", kind: "url", description: "Server-sent events at a URL – older remote servers" }, ]
properties.description: The transports offered when adding a server

properties.name: authOptions
properties.default: [ { id: "none", label: "None" }, { id: "token", label: "Bearer token", credential: true }, { id: "oauth", label: "OAuth", description: "The app signs in when it first connects" }, ]
properties.description: The auth options offered when adding a server

properties.name: credentials
properties.description: The credential references offered when the auth needs one

properties.name: statusLabels
properties.description: The statuses' names, merged over MCP_STATUS_LABELS

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Names the group, shown at the top

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading

properties.name: note
properties.default: "Which agents may use each tool is set in tool permissions."
properties.description: A quiet line beside Add server; empty hides it

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the servers as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the list out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A server was added or removed, or a form reset put the list back ({ value, change }: McpValueChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-connect
events.description: Connect or Retry was pressed ({ server, signal, retry }: McpConnectEvent); connect, then update `connections`. Cancelable – prevented, nothing shows as connecting

events.name: tc-disconnect
events.description: Disconnect was pressed ({ server }: McpDisconnectEvent); disconnect, then update `connections`

events.name: tc-test
events.description: Test was pressed in the add form ({ server, signal }: McpTestEvent); try it and report on `connections[server.id]`. Cancelable

methods.name: statusOf
methods.description: The status shown for a server: connecting while the app hasn't answered, else what the app says

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Asks the app to connect a server, as Connect does

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Stops a connect or test in progress: its signal aborts

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The servers to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after a server is added or removed, and what changed

props.name: onConnect
props.type: (server: McpServer, signal: AbortSignal, retry: boolean) => void
props.description: Connect or Retry was pressed: connect, stop when `signal` aborts, then update `connections`

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Disconnect was pressed, or a tested server was never added: disconnect it, then update `connections`

props.name: onTest
props.description: Test was pressed in the add form: try the server and report on `connections[server.id]`

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: Form association (ElementInternals)
features.why: The element's value is submitted with its form, and it takes part in form validation and reset.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: @property
features.without: The registered custom properties don't interpolate, so the transitions and spins they drive jump to their end state.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
